scope: Canonical lockfile-v1 JSON from the owned projected document, including exact Go string escaping and empty arrays/final LF. Strict reading/matching, persistence and compiler/CLI consumption remain pending.
stringPolicy: Valid UTF-8 strings match encoding/json escaping for controls, quotes, backslashes, HTML bytes, U+2028/U+2029 and raw other Unicode. Invalid UTF-8 rejects before publishing, rather than Go replacement behavior, since projected lock fields are validated UTF-8.
bounds: 8-MiB output ceiling and existing shared 16777216 work meter. Safe string runs append in slices, without per-byte runtime append calls. No partial output escapes failures.
fixtureReaderCorrection: The old file_source load and manifest helpers both cap reads at 65536 bytes. String boundary fixtures now use project_source_file.read with explicit 1048576 maximum, retaining the 65537-byte input case. Earlier native failures were fixture reader assertions, not claimed serializer passes.
